claude.sample_unit: patients (EHR development cohort); 2,348 NHANES participants for external validation

links.outcome: Calibration of prediction model before vs after logistic recalibration in external NHANES data
links.effect: Before recalibration: intercept 0.102, slope 1.097, ICI 0.020; after recalibration: intercept -0.000, slope 1, ICI 0.004; C-statistic unchanged at 0.787.
links.quote: The approximation model had a C-statistic of 0.787 when applied to NHANES and showed miscalibration and overestimation (Table 2 and Fig. 4 ; Intercept 0.102; Slope 1.097; ICI 0.020), but the calibration improved after recalibration (Table 2 and Fig. 5 ; Intercept -0.000; Slope 1; ICI 0.004).

links.outcome: Discrimination and calibration of EHR-derived model in external nationally representative NHANES data
links.effect: External validation gave C-statistic 0.787 (vs optimism-corrected 0.763 in development) but miscalibration with overestimation (intercept 0.102), correctable by recalibration.
links.quote: The approximation model discriminated well in the NHANES dataset, achieving a C-statistic of 0.787.

links.effect: External NHANES validation achieved C-statistic 0.787 but showed miscalibration and overestimation.
links.quote: The approximation model had a C-statistic of 0.787 when applied to NHANES and showed miscalibration and overestimation (Table 2 and Fig. 4 ; Intercept 0.102; Slope 1.097; ICI 0.020), but the calibration improved after recalibration (Table 2 and Fig. 5 ; Intercept -0.000; Slope 1; ICI 0.004).

The approximation model had a C-statistic of 0.787 when applied to NHANES and showed miscalibration and overestimation (Table 2 and Fig. 4 ; Intercept 0.102; Slope 1.097; ICI 0.020), but the calibration improved after recalibration (Table 2 and Fig. 5 ; Intercept -0.000; Slope 1; ICI 0.004).

links.effect: Optimism-corrected C-statistics were 0.760 for LASSO and 0.763 for approximation.
links.quote: Both the LASSO and approximation models demonstrated similar discrimination in the EHR cohort, with optimism-corrected C-statistics of 0.760 and 0.763, respectively.

links.effect: LASSO external validation was impossible because some predictor variables were unavailable.
links.quote: External validation of the LASSO model was not possible due to the unavailability of some predictor variables.
